aboutPage.meta.description: HatchGrab builds software for food trucks and mobile catering: online orders, pickup times and fewer repeated questions. Founded by Dominic Bonini.
aboutPage.story.build: We build practical software specifically for food trucks and mobile caterers, helping them take online orders, manage collection times, keep orders flowing smoothly and spend less time dealing with repetitive questions.

comparison.faq.capacityA: Customers only see collection times your kitchen can actually make. The system works from each dish's preparation time and how many you prepare at once.
comparison.faq.termA: No. There is no minimum term and no notice period. You can cancel any time; the fee is billed monthly in advance, and you keep access until the end of the month you have paid for. [minimum contract term]
comparison.faq.termQ: Is there a minimum term? [minimum contract term]
comparison.faq.tseA: HatchGrab is not a till system and is not certified under the tax rules for cash registers. How you record online orders in your till system is a question for your accountant.
comparison.faq.tseQ: Do I still need a till with a TSE?
comparison.faq.whatA: An ordering system takes orders online before customers reach the truck: they choose dishes and a collection time, pay online or on collection, and the order appears in your kitchen. A till or card machine takes payment at the truck. The two complement each other.

comparison.fit.marketplacesBody: Delivery platforms bring new customers but take commission on every order. Uber Eats states 14% for collection and 30% for delivery by Uber couriers in Germany. Wolt says on its own website that it charges commission but gives no rates. We could not check Lieferando’s rates. That commission applies to regulars who pre-order with you, too.
comparison.fit.oursBody: you trade at changing locations, want pre-orders with a collection time, don't want your kitchen overloaded, and don't want a contract.
comparison.fit.oursNotBody: your customers should pay with PayPal or Klarna, or you want a certified till with a TSE from one supplier.
comparison.fit.tillsBody: Till systems take payment at the truck and meet the tax requirements of a certified cash register. An ordering system works alongside a till system; it does not replace it.
comparison.fit.tillsBodyNamed: Till systems take payment at the truck and meet the tax requirements of a certified cash register. {names} also {count, plural, one {appears} many {appear} other {appear}} in the table above. An ordering system works alongside a till system; it does not replace it.

goLive.allergensUnanswered.detail: Until you choose, customers see none of your dishes — the menu protects itself by hiding anything whose allergens are unconfirmed, and right now that is everything.
goLive.kitchenCapacityUnset.detail: No capacity is set for {vans}. Without it we will keep promising customers collection times your kitchen has no way to hit.
goLive.noPrepBearingCategory.detail: {categories, select, none {You have no menu categories yet, so we have no way to work out how long an order takes.} other {None of your categories has a cooking time set, so every order looks instant to us. We would keep giving customers collection times your kitchen has no chance of hitting, and the busier you get the further out they would be.}}
kitchenCapacity.example: Example: if you can cook 4 mains in 5 minutes, then set it to 4 items every 5 minutes. The total capacity limits orders across all selected categories so if you want to only sell a maximum of 10 starters and mains every 5 minutes, then set Total capacity to 10 items every 5 minutes and tick the Starters and Mains boxes. This will still keep your mains restricted to 4 items every 5 minutes.
kitchenCapacity.lead: How many items your kitchen can make, so customers can only pick collection times you can meet.
kitchenModals.extraWait.hint: Adds to the collection time quoted on new orders. It does not change the event finish time.
landing.does.capacityBody: Set how much you can cook at once, and how long it takes. Once a collection time is full, customers can’t pick it.
landing.does.devicesBody: Runs on the phone in your apron, the tablet on the counter, the laptop in the van — and the card machine you already take payment on.
landing.does.slotsBody: Customers order ahead and pick a collection time. Fewer queues, and food ready when they arrive.
landing.faq.metaDescription: Clear answers for food trucks on HatchGrab’s prices, getting started, taking online orders and taking payment by card or at pickup.
landing.final.lede: Upload a photo or screenshot of your menu and we’ll turn it into a working ordering page for you to have a play around with in under 60 seconds. Your items, your prices. No sign-up, no card, nothing to install. Have a look, then decide.
